title: Allahabad High Court: LDA Brochure Clause Allowing 20% Deduction Without Interest Is Unfair
case_name: Lucknow Development Authority v. Shivaji Singh
citation: RERA Appeal No. 118 of 2026; 2026 LLBiz HC (ALL) 87
card_summary: The Allahabad High Court held that a Lucknow Development Authority brochure clause, letting it keep 20% of a registration amount and refund the rest without interest, is one-sided and unreasonable under basic contract principles. The LDA could not rely on the clause to deny interest. The ruling upholds the refund after the 20% deduction, but with interest at MCLR plus 1% until payment.
card_tip: A brochure clause denying interest on a forfeited-and-refunded deposit will not survive appellate scrutiny; price in interest at the applicable rate when drafting or relying on such clauses.
